problems: Abroad fix 1, interest by country: when a term deposit's interest is taken during the term (bank.take_term_interest, accountlife.ts:391-405), it is paid into the primary current account. interestPaidSince (accountlife.ts:169-172) finds that payment by its memo, and the reversal (:457-461) takes it back out of the primary. But interestBackOf (:175-178) counts only postings on the term itself, so it counts 0, and cancelRefusal (:210) never sees it. Probe (scratchpad/probe/term2.ts), Berlin: Commerzbank primary; a €10,000 term at Deutsche Bank; 10 days; Take Interest pays €6.30 into the Commerzbank GiroKonto; the GiroKonto is spent to €0. Cancel It is not refused, and the primary ends at -€6.30. With a Postbank term the result is -€6.08. The panel says nothing, and the guide's refusal 'The interest it was paid, …, goes back, and is more than it holds' is never given. Reachable abroad at every EU/EEA bank with interestDuringTerm: Deutsche Bank, Postbank, Berliner Sparkasse, AIB, Íslandsbanki and Bankinter.

Abroad fix 2, Canada's charges: chargesBackOf (accountlife.ts:181-184) refunds every 'bank_fee' transaction since opening. Overdraft interest is posted as 'bank_fee' (lending.ts:1053, nominal 'Overdraft Interest'), so Canada refunds it. That goes against SOR/2021-181 s.5(2)(b) 'other than interest charges', which the code's own comment at :160-165 quotes. The refund is also credited against the 'Bank Fees' nominal, not 'Overdraft Interest'. Probe (scratchpad/probe/odint.ts), Toronto: RBC chequing opened on 26 January beside TD, C$1,000 arranged, C$500 under until February. Charges: monthly fee C$16.95, overdraft interest C$1.81, overdraft fee C$5.00. Canceled on 2 February, the refund is C$23.76, the C$1.81 of interest included.

These remain defects of the row abroad.
